lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，我的脚掌触地声响亮！
lines.en: Sssss, my feet make loud sounds on the ground!
I need leaves, lots of trees!

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，步履沉重！
lines.en: I'm massive, my steps are heavy!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我会飞得很高！
lines.en: Stay back, I can fly high!

lines.zh: 我太重了，地面都会颤动！
lines.en: I'm too heavy, the ground trembles!

lines.zh: 我寻找高树，上面有美味树叶！
lines.en: I search for tall trees, they have tasty leaves!

lines.zh: 我的皮肤厚实，抵御一切！
lines.en: My skin is thick, it withstands all!

lines.zh: 我不会飞行，只能在地上行走！
lines.en: I don't fly, I just walk on the ground!
I'm big, my movements are slow!
I eat leaves, making forests green!

lines.zh: 小短腿踩得落叶嘎吱响
lines.en: Little legs crunch through the leaves
I look up at the canopy. Out of reach.
My neck is not long enough yet. Wait.

lines.zh: 四条腿一起迈，摇摇晃晃

lines.en: I crushed a patch of small ferns

lines.zh: 我不会攻击，只是吃树叶！
lines.en: I don't attack, just eat leaves!

lines.zh: 我在这里等待，等待机会！
lines.en: I wait here, for a chance!
I wait for a chance to eat!

lines.zh: 我静静地等待，等待食物！

lines.en: I eat leaves, waiting for food!
Napping in the shade of a tree

lines.zh: 把鼻子贴在温热的石头上
lines.en: Nose pressed to a warm stone

lines.zh: 听远处成年腕龙的脚步
lines.en: Listening to the adult brachi's footsteps
What are you doing? Stay away!
You're looking at me? Don't come closer!
Why are you looking at me? Don't come!
Why are you looking? Don't come!

lines.zh: 你半跪下来，我才敢靠近
lines.en: You kneel halfway, and I dare come closer

lines.zh: 歪着头看你手里的嫩叶
lines.en: Tilting my head at the young leaves in your hand
Want to ride me? I am still too small

lines.zh: 渴望成年那庞大的身躯

lines.en: Low call for同类 to gather

lines.zh: 轻触树叶感受风的温柔
lines.en: Gently touching leaves feeling the breeze

lines.zh: 仰望成年身影感到安心
lines.en: Looking up at the adult's form with comfort

lines.zh: 在温暖阳光下享受成长
等我长到十三个格子高
lines.en: Wait until I am thirteen blocks tall

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯碰撞发出轰响
lines.en: Body collision makes a loud sound

lines.zh: 强壮的后腿撞击力量惊人
lines.en: Strong hind legs have surprising power

lines.zh: 被撞击的生物发出惨叫
在空中翻滚后安全着地
lines.en: Rolls in the air before safely landing

lines.zh: 在巨大撞击中寻找平衡
巨大的身躯撞击后摇晃
缠绕对方共同寻找食物
lines.en: Circling each other to find food

lines.zh: 幼腕龙体型娇小，不易捉摸。
lines.en: Baby Brachiosaurus is hard to catch.

lines.zh: 轻轻一碰，幼腕龙就会颤抖。
lines.en: A gentle touch makes the baby tremble.

lines.zh: 幼腕龙喜欢吃树叶和树枝。
幼腕龙叫声如铃铛般清脆。
小心，幼腕龙会用尾巴攻击。
那棵树顶的叶子，我够得着。
lines.en: The leaves at the top of that tree are within reach.
Leaves far away catch its eye.

lines.zh: 它对高处的食物感兴趣。

lines.en: There are new buds at the top of that tree
This patch of leaves is mine
Target set on the highest branch
Stretching my neck, half a block short
Front hooves on the trunk, shaking it
Almost there, just a little more
One strong nudge and the leaves fall
I only want the young leaves in the crown

lines.zh: 瞄准了那串最绿的叶子
我还够不着高树，先咬你的靴子。
lines.en: I cannot reach the tall trees yet, so I bite your boot.
I'll stab you with my horn!
My teeth are sharp as knives!

lines.zh: 我还够不着高树，先咬你靴子。
lines.en: I cannot reach the tall trees yet, so I bite your boots.

lines.zh: 我的体型庞大，无法抵挡！

lines.en: I'll block you with my body!
My little tail whips your leg

lines.zh: 我第一次用前蹄撞东西
lines.en: My first hit with my front hooves
My neck is still short; I'll grow first.

lines.zh: 培育器开了，我踩到苔藓。
lines.en: The incubator opened and I stepped onto moss.
I'm a baby from the Jurassic!
Fresh from the egg, my legs are still soft.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里钻出来，湿漉漉的
lines.en: I hatch out of the egg, still wet

lines.zh: 育龙器打开了，我探出头
lines.en: The incubator opens, and I poke my head out
The first thing I see is a big tree
I stand beside the organic slime
My legs could barely hold me when I was born

lines.zh: 化石里的基因把我唤醒了
lines.en: Genes from the fossil woke me
I am here, a tiny brachiosaurus

lines.zh: 第一次抬头，就看见树顶
lines.en: My first look up finds the treetops
I shake the slime off my shell
That height is cruel to a calf.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击烧伤幼小身躯
长脖子伸出去，什么也没够到。
lines.en: My long neck reaches out and finds nothing.
